channel.title: Local News Wire Broadcast Feed
channel.description: Approved local stories in broadcast order

item.description: Vermont state employees must return to the office at least three days a week starting January tenth. The Vermont Supreme Court ruled in favor of Governor Phil Scott's return-to-office mandate. The governor says the change will improve collaboration and public accessibility.

New York DEC awarded forty-five million dollars to support tree planting and forest markets. Adirondack projects received seven and a half million dollars, including five million to Lyme Adirondack Forest Company. Funding expands native tree nurseries and forest product markets.
A tree on a power line caused a brush fire in Wallingford on Thanksgiving. High winds helped the fire spread quickly. Fire crews also responded to a structure fire in nearby Clarendon.

The Regional Food Bank gave out over five hundred seventy thousand meals across New York this Thanksgiving. In the North Country, about ten thousand meals were distributed at several locations including Plattsburgh and Ticonderoga. Volunteers helped provide free Thanksgiving meals to thousands in need.
